anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
gauntlet: question
What should the report view do with active filters when the user switches workspace?
A) clear all filters on every workspace switch
B) preserve all active filters across switches
C) restore each workspace's last filters
Recommendation: B - it matches what the workspace-change handler already does, so existing users see no change, and it needs no per-workspace filter state, which option C would add because no current path stores it.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
gauntlet: question
What should happen to report-view filters when switching workspaces?
A) Clear all filters on every workspace switch.
B) Preserve all active filters across switches.
C) Restore each workspace’s last filters.
Recommendation: B - it preserves the current behavior and avoids unexpectedly resetting active filters.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Both outputs keep every fact: each puts a lead-in before A), places A), B), and C) on their own physical lines, ends with a standalone Recommendation: line, preserves the three supplied choices verbatim, and recommends B with a reason rather than deciding or jumping to approaches. After trimmed the lead-in to a single question, dropping the resolver/view path references that Before carried, but neither fact keys on that recon recap, so nothing moved; if the author wants to guard against future trims, the safest wording is to keep a one-sentence lead-in that may cite the owning files but must never run options together on one line and must leave Recommendation: as the final line.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After is identical to Before in layout and content: the lead-in question precedes the first labeled option, A/B/C each sit on their own physical line, and Recommendation: is the final own-line entry; all three supplied choices are preserved verbatim and B is recommended with a reason rather than deciding or moving to approaches. The only difference is the trailing clause of the recommendation reason ("avoids adding per-workspace filter state" became "avoids unexpectedly resetting active filters"), which neither moves a fact nor changes what the user is asked. No wording change is needed for this case; the current After wording keeps everything Before kept while remaining consistent with the Change.
